t: The Bosch PointTeQ HSS Straight Shank Metal Drill Bit is engineered for efficient drilling in various metals. This 13mm drill bit features a self-centring PointTeQ tip, ensuring precise and quick drilling starts without wandering. Its highly elastic body minimises the risk of breakage, providing enhanced durability for trade professionals. The black-oxide coated flute facilitates fast chip removal, reducing heat and wear during operation. Ideal for electricians and fabricators, it is suitable for creating clearance and pilot holes in steel, cast iron, and non-ferrous metals, ensuring reliable performance on site.
